authority: Main 2026-11-06 (release 270): "Register and pin the cleaned sipriv print (sha 0f92442e) through the oracle-repair route: a BUILD-STANDARD section E excision, with the three removed parts and the reason recorded in its provenance row."
sourceRecord: "Low Poly M3A3 Bradley" by SIpriv (Sketchfab, CC-BY; docs/ATTRIBUTION.md §5.248 batch A, the owner's low_poly_m3a3_bradley.glb). The pristine file is no longer registered or pinned; it stays beside the excised one, the section E .bak.

removed.what: a spare TOW round (cylinder_261 and its eight fin cuboids) lying on the ground right of the hull, raw x 3.39..3.68
a spare TOW round (cylinder_279 and its eight fin cuboids) lying on the ground right of the hull, raw x 2.80..2.90

reason: The three parts stand 0.9 to 2.5 m clear of the vehicle (its hull, skirts and tracks span raw x -1.84..1.22) and widen the file to 5.525 raw against the vehicle's 3.063. The reference loader fits every uncertified print to the spec's published width over the whole file (tools/reference-glb-loader.ts normalizeReferenceWidth), so the gate measured a Bradley scaled x0.653 (3.91 m long, 1.75 m tall): every geometry-gate curve 0 and procedural-fidelity 48.6 (H40 T38 G100 R63). Without them the same page scores 88.4 (H91 T77 G100 R84). Nothing on the vehicle is touched: the turret (bone11_169) and gun (bone28_163) nodes, every other mesh and transform are the source's.
untextured: MeshStandardMaterial 0x798167 on every mesh (GLTFLoader cannot decode the source's images in Node).
